text: {"lessons":["Buying the same number of shares in every stock used cash quickly; I should check my cash and overall exposure before adding to positions.","Selling Stock A after a large gain realized a profit, but one successful sale does not prove I can time the market; I should use a consistent plan for when to sell.","My account value changed substantially while I made no trades, so I should judge progress over longer periods and not react to short-term price swings."]}
